D: Two energy drink salesmen get sentenced to community service mentoring a medieval role-playing teen and a foul-mouthed kid.
P: Serve the snacks when the battle at LAIRE begins.
S: the LAIRE battle in the park and the court of King Argotron

Chicken drumsticks rubbed with garlic, rosemary and smoked paprika, roasted until crisp, then glazed with honey mustard to be eaten by hand like a medieval feast. Heat the oven to 200C. Rub 12 chicken drumsticks with 2 tbsp oil, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tbsp chopped rosemary, 2 tsp smoked paprika and salt. Roast on a lined tray for 35 minutes. Mix 3 tbsp honey and 2 tbsp wholegrain mustard, brush over and roast 10 minutes more until sticky. Wrap the bones in baking paper and serve on a board.
Sturdy Wings honey soy chicken wings
Sturdy Wings, the mentoring programme Danny and Wheeler are sentenced to

Chicken wings baked crisp and tossed in a sticky honey, soy, garlic and ginger glaze with sesame seeds and spring onion. Heat the oven to 220C. Toss 1.2kg chicken wings with 2 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt and bake on a rack for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Simmer 4 tbsp honey, 3 tbsp soy, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp grated ginger and 1 tbsp rice vinegar for 3 minutes until syrupy. Toss the wings in the glaze and scatter with sesame seeds and sliced spring onion.
M: Wheeler finally getting through to Ronnie

Two thin smashed patties with melted cheese, onion, pickles and a tangy burger sauce in toasted buns, with crunchy seasoned fries. Bake 750g frozen fries at 220C for 25 minutes and toss with salt and paprika. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls. Smash flat on a very hot plate, season and cook 2 minutes, flip, add cheese and cook 1 minute. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp mustard and chopped pickles. Toast 4 buns, spread with sauce and stack 2 patties with diced onion and pickles.
W: Kingdom of LAIRE honey spice cakes

Little honey and mixed spice cakes baked golden, soaked with warm orange honey syrup and topped with a spoon of thick cream and toasted almonds. Heat the oven to 175C. Melt 125g butter with 150g honey, cool slightly, then whisk in 2 eggs. Fold in 200g self-raising flour, 1 tsp mixed spice and 80ml milk. Divide between 12 greased muffin holes and bake 18 to 20 minutes. Warm 4 tbsp honey with the juice of 1 orange and spoon over the hot cakes. Serve with thick cream and toasted flaked almonds.
K: the Minotaur energy drink Danny and Wheeler sell to schools

Fresh ginger and lime syrup with a pinch of chilli, topped with soda over crushed ice, sharp and fiery with a lime and mint garnish. Simmer 100g sliced ginger, 120g sugar, 150ml water and a pinch of chilli flakes for 10 minutes. Cool and strain. Fill 4 tall glasses with crushed ice. Add 40ml ginger syrup and 25ml lime juice to each and top with 200ml cold soda water. Stir and garnish with a lime wheel and mint.
